# Lithium Downstream Summit 2026

> A two-day in-person summit in Melbourne, Australia focused on lithium refining, project bankability, capital deployment, and battery supply chain security. Organised by iQ-Hub.

- Location: Melbourne, Victoria, Australia

- Date: December 2026 (exact dates published on the Program page)

- Format: In-person conference

- Industry: Critical Minerals and Battery Supply Chain

- [Home](https://www.australia.lithium-downstream-summit.com/): Event overview, themes, and highlights

- [Agenda](https://www.australia.lithium-downstream-summit.com/agenda-page): Full event agenda and session details (requires email signup and verification)

- [Who Should Attend](https://www.australia.lithium-downstream-summit.com/who-should-attend): Target audience and delegate benefits

- [Featured Speakers](https://www.australia.lithium-downstream-summit.com/featured-speakers): Confirmed speaker lineup

- [Sponsors](https://www.australia.lithium-downstream-summit.com/sponsors): Sponsorship partners and exhibitors

- [Venue](https://www.australia.lithium-downstream-summit.com/venue): Location and logistics

- [News](https://www.australia.lithium-downstream-summit.com/news): Industry news and event updates

- [Register](https://www.australia.lithium-downstream-summit.com/booking): Delegate registration and booking
